- [core/Page](/framework/core/Page/) — Overview is a `browse()` wall, four bands (Pages are navigation · The box · Recipes · JS, last), 20 live cards; [old](/framework/core/Page/old/) keeps the first docs under a `.tabs.vertical` rail, with a 4th level of top tabs tried inside `old/overview` (legible, subtle).
